- tests/test_mark_stable_release_tag_refspec_contract.py:111-114 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `assert "origin/main" not in text` check is a broad substring match that can fail on harmless future comments or documentation text mentioning `origin/main`.
  WHY: The paired `git fetch origin main` check is precise already, so this extra substring guard is redundant and brittle to non-code text changes.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- tests/test_mark_stable_release_tag_refspec_contract.py:212 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The negative regex guard `r'^\s*git push origin "\$\{VERSION_TAG\}"\s*$'` only matches `${VERSION_TAG}` and would miss a regression to `$VERSION_TAG`.
  WHY: The test would still pass if the bare refspec were reintroduced in the workflow source, weakening the regression guard.
- tests/test_mark_stable_release_tag_refspec_contract.py:218 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The negative regex guard `r'^\s*git push -f origin "\$\{MAJOR\}"\s*$'` only matches `${MAJOR}` and would miss a regression to `$MAJOR`.
  WHY: The test would still pass if the bare refspec were reintroduced in the workflow source, weakening the regression guard.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:28-30 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The script hardcodes `origin` for all `git push` commands.
  WHY: Manual invocation against a repository using a different remote name would fail at runtime.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- tests/test_mark_stable_release_tag_refspec_contract.py:57, 65, 68-73 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The cross-pollination reviewer incorrectly claimed the negative-regex assertions are broken; the raw-string regexes correctly match literal bare forms in the workflow source text.
  WHY: `\$` and `\{`/`\}` are the correct regex escapes for literal dollar signs and braces, so the guards do catch bare refspec regressions as intended.
- tests/test_mark_stable_release_tag_refspec_contract.py:111-114 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `assert "origin/main" not in text and "git fetch origin main" not in text` check is a blind substring match that is brittle to harmless comments or docs mentioning `origin/main`.
  WHY: The `git fetch origin main` portion is already the precise guard, so the broader substring check can create false positives on future text-only changes.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:28-30 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The script hardcodes `origin` as the remote name for release pushes.
  WHY: This is consistent with the repo’s workflows and not a defect for the canonical use case, but it is a documented limitation for non-standard remotes.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:28-30 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: All `git push` commands hardcode the `origin` remote name.
  WHY: Manual invocations against repositories without an `origin` remote, or with a renamed remote, would fail before completing the release tags.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
